scope: The Plutus script contexts the build of the public Leios testnet (release rc-2026w44) collects for a Dijkstra top-level transaction before evaluation (mkDijkstraStAnnTopTx at protocol version 12.0, a PlutusV4 cost model of 251 zeros, slots of one second from the POSIX epoch): for each case the ToCBOR PlutusWithContext encoding of every context of the top-level transaction and of each sub-transaction, or the collection's failure. Scripts are placeholders, never deserialised or evaluated.

reference.plutus: plutus-core and plutus-ledger-api 1.71.0.0 (261766ad1d582bce8c86bad1af7a3b0e5355b21c), the versions the release's node binary links
